events.text: The Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle ends the War of the Austrian Succession.
The United States formally takes possession of Alaska from Russia.
The British Broadcasting Company (BBC) is founded.
Texas Instruments announces the first transistor radio.
Tennis for Two, one of the first video games, is demonstrated in New York.
The Soviet probe Venera 4 enters the atmosphere of Venus.
West German commandos free the hostages on hijacked Lufthansa Flight 181 in Mogadishu.

births.text: Chuck Berry, American rock and roll pioneer
